teaser.en: Its white flowers open at night and fall by morning, filling the beach air with scent while most people are asleep.
teaser.sw: Maua yake meupe huchanua usiku na kupukutika kufikia asubuhi, yakijaza hewa ya ufuoni harufu nzuri wakati watu wengi wamelala.

summary.en: *Mkungu wa pwani*, the beach gardenia, is a small seaside tree with large rounded leaves and fragrant white flowers that open at night. Its Digo name compares it to the Indian almond, the *mkungu*.
summary.sw: *Mkungu wa pwani* (kwa Kiingereza *beach gardenia*) ni mti mdogo wa pwani wenye majani makubwa ya mviringo na maua meupe yenye harufu nzuri yanayochanua usiku. Jina lake la Kidigo linaulinganisha na *mkungu* (*Indian almond*).

about.en: *Mkungu wa pwani* is a small tree or large shrub with big, rounded leaves, soft and slightly hairy, clustered at the ends of the branches. Its flowers are white, tubular and very fragrant, opening in the evening and dropping by morning. The fruit is a small, hard, round drupe with a corky layer that lets it float on the sea, which is how the tree has spread to beaches all around the tropics.
about.sw: *Mkungu wa pwani* ni mti mdogo au kichaka kikubwa chenye majani makubwa ya mviringo, laini na yenye malaika kidogo, yaliyojikusanya kwenye ncha za matawi. Maua yake ni meupe, yenye umbo la mrija na harufu nzuri sana; huchanua jioni na kupukutika kufikia asubuhi. Tunda ni kokwa dogo, gumu na la mviringo lenye tabaka la kizibo linaloliwezesha kuelea baharini, na hivyo ndivyo mti huu ulivyoenea hadi fukwe zote za ukanda wa tropiki.

where.en: It grows on sandy and coral beach tops, at the very back of the beach where the sand meets the bush. Look for its broad leaves among the shrubs above the high-tide line, and for fallen white flowers on the sand early in the morning.
where.sw: Huota juu ya fukwe za mchanga na za matumbawe, nyuma kabisa ya ufuo pale mchanga unapokutana na vichaka. Utayaona majani yake mapana kati ya vichaka vilivyo juu ya mstari wa maji makuu, na maua meupe yaliyoanguka juu ya mchanga alfajiri.

uses.en: No particular uses have been recorded among the Digo so far.
uses.sw: Hadi sasa hakuna matumizi maalumu yaliyorekodiwa miongoni mwa Wadigo.

culture.en: The Digo named it by comparison with the *mkungu*, the Indian almond, because it grows at the seaside. *Pwani* means the coast or seashore, so the name means 'the *mkungu* of the seaside'.
culture.sw: Wadigo waliupa jina kwa kuulinganisha na *mkungu*, kwa sababu huota pwani. *Pwani* ina maana ya pwani au ufuo wa bahari, hivyo jina lina maana ya '*mkungu* wa pwani'.

names.en: Pakia records the Digo name *mkungu wa pwani*. No Swahili name has been recorded. In English it is the beach gardenia, and its scientific name is *Guettarda speciosa*.
names.sw: Pakia anarekodi jina la Kidigo *mkungu wa pwani*. Hakuna jina la Kiswahili lililorekodiwa. Kwa Kiingereza unaitwa *beach gardenia*, na jina lake la kisayansi ni *Guettarda speciosa*.
